description: OVERLAND PARK, KS — Today, on the final day to register to vote in Kansas before the November election, Representative Sharice Davids joined local leaders and community volunteers for a nonpartisan voter registration drive aimed at helping every eligible Kansan make their voice heard this fall. “Our democracy is at its strongest when every eligible voter […]
